project.domain: Minimal x86_64 kernel substrate and boot contracts
project.mission: Develop an early kernel bring-up foundation with explicit architecture, boot, memory, execution, and device boundaries.

explicit_non_goals: Do not merge Multiboot2 and Limine paths without explicit design and evidence
Scheduler, SMP, ACPI, drivers, VFS, networking, userspace, and GUI are not implied to exist

safety_boundaries: Keep boot paths and their memory/entry contracts distinct until an explicit integration is qualified.
Host builds and QEMU smoke tests are not physical-hardware qualification.
USB/image writing is destructive and must retain exact-device confirmation and safety checks.
Do not claim unimplemented OS subsystems or target support.

native_validation.evidence_note: QEMU/BIOS/UEFI checks are emulator evidence; physical-target qualification is a separate gate.
